id.description: Game server id; pass it as `serverId` to other integration calls (promo redeem)

lifecycle.description: PRE_LAUNCH — not open yet, OPEN — open to players, CLOSED — closed. The set may grow: skip a value you do not know

name.description: Display name of the game server

purpose.description: PRODUCTION — a live game server, TEST — a test stand. The set may grow: skip a value you do not know

slug.description: Game server slug; send it as the `Server-Slug` header of other integration calls

platformApiKey.description: API key of the tenant, sent as `Authorization: Bearer nx_api_...`. The key determines the tenant; the scopes granted to it determine which operations it may call.

info.description: Third-party integration surface of nx-tenants. Authenticate every request with the API key of your tenant (your project on the L2NX platform): `Authorization: Bearer nx_api_...`. How to get a key and which errors it can produce: [Authentication](https://l2nx.dev/api/authentication/). The game server list needs scope `tenants.game-servers:read`. The tenant is the one the API key belongs to; a key used on another tenant's host is rejected with 403 `API_KEY_TENANT_MISMATCH`. Do NOT send a `Tenant-Slug` header yourself.
info.title: nx-tenants — Integration API

get.description: List the game servers of your tenant: production and test, pre-launch, open and closed, whether or not their adapter is connected. Filter by `purpose` and `lifecycle` yourself and skip values you do not know. Use `id` as `serverId` and `slug` as the `Server-Slug` header in other calls.

200.description: Every game server of the tenant in display order; an empty array when it has none

401.description: No `Authorization: Bearer` header, a malformed key or an unknown key

403.description: The key is not allowed here; `code` is `API_KEY_REVOKED`, `API_KEY_EXPIRED`, `TENANT_SUSPENDED`, `TENANT_CLOSED` (on a shared host; on a tenant host a suspended or closed tenant gets `404 TENANT_NOT_FOUND`), `API_KEY_TENANT_MISMATCH` (a key of another tenant than the host) or `INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE`

404.description: On a tenant host: the tenant is unknown, suspended or closed (`TENANT_NOT_FOUND`)

429.description: Too many requests with this key to this operation (`RATE_LIMITED`); limits: https://l2nx.dev/api/overview/#rate-limits

503.description: The tenant directory is not loaded yet (`TENANT_DIRECTORY_UNAVAILABLE`); retry after `Retry-After` seconds

get.summary: List the game servers of your tenant

tenant.description: Tenant slug: your dedicated API host prefix
